claim_scope: BIZPROOF verifies explicit scalar semantic adapters derived from locked external business-rule implementations and independently traceable tests/specifications. It does not claim end-to-end proof of the original frameworks.

interpretation.mutants: secondary sensitivity check only; injected mutants are not external defects
interpretation.not_claimed: no end-to-end proof of the original external framework function or its object/database aggregation machinery
interpretation.proved: formal proof of the tracked scalar adapter against the tracked contract over its declared input domain
